text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been dealing with a<n>streak of awful
luck. Birds pooping on<n>me, losing my favorite
pen—the list<n>goes on and on...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And today, while walking with a<n>coffee in hand...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Are you all right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yikes. I think you must have been<n>right about all
that bad luck...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I've got an idea! It's times like<n>these when you
need some<n>dependable advice, right? And I know
just who to ask!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Great Fortune! ☆<n>I'll drive all
those pesky calamities<n>away and bring good
omens!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First, this space could use a feng shui<n>boost. ☆ The
windows, the desk... This<n>whole interior is in need
of<n>improvement!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to help out in any way<n>I can. Please,
bring Trainer some<n>better luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following Copano Rickey's guidance,<n>we give my
office a deep clean and<n>rearrange the furniture.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Craaash!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A-are you all right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything I had neatly arranged on<n>my desk is
now back in disarray. I'll<n>have to organize it once
again...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This is one sticky situation.<n>Despite my
efforts to ward it away,<n>negative qi continues to
gather here...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've tried every single trick in the<n>book. I'm not
sure what more I can<n>do.
choice_data_list: Maybe it's time to just accept my fate...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, actually, I have a grand plan<n>of my own too!
I won't let you stay<n>unlucky forever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If you two could wait for me at the<n>outdoor stage,
that'd be great!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry for the hold up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The gods should be able to boost<n>your luck, so I'll
have a talk with<n>them myself!
choice_data_list: You're going to... talk with the gods?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm going to ask them to help<n>you out by
giving you a big helping of<n>good luck.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And to make sure they can hear me, I<n>put on this
outfit that I got from the<n>shrine the other day!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The design is meant to resemble a<n>crane, and they
say that cranes are<n>messengers that deliver our
voices to<n>the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oho, good-luck garb to invite fortune! I<n>think a happy
omen might be coming<n>your way!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it a go! This is a wish from<n>the bottom of
my heart... Please,<n>liberate Trainer from this
misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hummm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of concern for my predicament,<n>Kitasan Black
sings a prayer with all<n>her might.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe! I can sense that positive qi is<n>flowing in to
wash the negative qi<n>away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One song later, and my mood has<n>completely turned
around. It seems<n>Kitasan Black was able to lift my
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So what's the verdict, Trainer?<n>Feeling any luckier?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I flex my arm in a show of gusto,<n>the pen I
thought I'd lost drops out of<n>my jacket!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah! Isn't that the pen you've been<n>looking for?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And in the blink of an eye, the lost<n>becomes found!
♪ Looks like Kita's<n>prayer has done the trick!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It could all be a coincidence,<n>but I'm glad I
was able to help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Did her heartfelt wish truly reach the<n>heavens?
After everything that<n>happened today, I can't help
but want<n>to believe it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! I'll sing as many times as<n>you need!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hummm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at that, you two! There's a<n>rainbow in
the sky!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely a good omen... Your<n>luck-boosting
prayer was a success!<n>☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yay! Next, I better tell the gods how<n>grateful I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's cheerful singing<n>voice echoes
through the sky for<n>quite some time.
